question: What measured evidence links intended bond, substrate context, kinetic performance, competing-substrate behavior, and secondary cleavage to target recognition for TDPn3, SAAc8, AbetaF3, and separately the TDPr3 redesign?

source.title: Computational design of metalloproteases
source.source_scope: Current v3 only; no facts inherited from PMC v1.

cross_target_conclusion.bond_specific_recognition: TDPn3 has the strongest bond-specific chain: intended cut 7, a matching reporter C-product mass, and matching C-product masses in two purified full-length TDP-43 construct states. TDPr3 supports intended cut 5 but also a cut after residue 3. SAAc8 and AbetaF3 show sequence-conditioned reporter turnover but no source-reported cut identity.
cross_target_conclusion.specificity: TDPn3, SAAc8 and AbetaF3 are reported to prefer their intended reporters in restricted panels; TDPr3 prefers its original scaffold substrate. The progress curves support qualitative preference, not quantitative cross-target selectivity, because reporter response is uncalibrated and the ED9 selectivity enzyme doses are not explicit.
cross_target_conclusion.campaign_inference: Counts 48, 113, 14, and 34 are tested-design denominators, not hit-rate denominators; selected fastest/most-active leads cannot be converted into 1/N successes.
cross_target_conclusion.secondary_cleavage: TDPr3 secondary cut 3 has product-mass support. TDPn3 cut 3 is an author annotation without a second listed C-product mass. Secondary-cleavage status is unmeasured for SAAc8 and AbetaF3.
unestablished: full-length target cleavage for SAAc8 or AbetaF3
endogenous intracellular activity for any lead
a matched cross-construct activity comparison between TDPn3 and TDPr3
cohort hit rates for any fixed-target campaign

author_deposit.finding: The recovered central-directory interval includes the fig5 branch with tdpa3_kinetics_specificity, masked_egfr and masked_cytokine, then transitions to rfd2mi_workflow. No SAAc8/AbetaF3 ED9 raw member was located in the inspected fig5 branch. This is a scoped search result, not proof that the entire deposit lacks such data.

conditions_recorded_in_notebook.reporter_concentration_interpretation: Retained notebook label, not a verified final concentration. Supplement 4.11 normalizes reporter stocks to 3 uM before 18+2 uL mixing; the dilution-derived final concentration is 2.7 uM assuming additive volumes.

recovered_tdp_a3_specificity_source.processing: Per-well time-zero subtraction followed by subtraction of the mean matched no-enzyme control. Publication curves plot sfGFP RFU in arbitrary units. A separate notebook calculation fits 0-1000 s RFU slopes.
recovered_tdp_a3_specificity_source.missing_for_quantitative_specificity: No per-reporter intact-versus-product fluorescence standard curve, molar-product conversion, or reporter-specific inner-filter correction is applied in the specificity notebook.
recovered_tdp_a3_specificity_source.identity_scope: The 500 nM dose and TDP-target preference align with the methods condition assigned to TDPn3 rather than the 6 uM TDPr3 condition, but the archive alias TDP-A3 is not mapped by an enzyme sequence to Table S4. This strengthens the TDPn3 reading of Fig. 5b without resolving the caption/text identity conflict.

ed9_raw_status.SAAc8: No raw progress-curve or fit table located in the inspected fig5 archive branch; printed ED9 values remain source-image transcription. The full archive was not exhaustively searched.
ed9_raw_status.AbetaF3: No raw progress-curve or fit table located in the inspected fig5 archive branch; printed ED9 values remain source-image transcription. The full archive was not exhaustively searched.

quantitative_comparison_decision.cognate_performance: The printed catalytic efficiencies share units and ED9/TDP kinetics captions specify 500 nM enzyme and triplicates, so they may be reported side by side as source-reported cognate performance. They compare different enzymes on different peptides and are not a measure of target recognition or selectivity.
quantitative_comparison_decision.specificity: A quantitative specificity comparison is not supported. The competing-substrate panels are raw arbitrary-unit fluorescence curves; ED9 panel enzyme doses are not stated unambiguously; and the per-reporter optical response is not calibrated to molar cleavage.
quantitative_comparison_decision.decision_changing_next_assay: Before ranking fixed-target recognition, measure every enzyme against the same reporter panel at matched active-enzyme concentration and buffer/Zn/temperature, convert each reporter signal with its own intact/product standard and inner-filter correction, and obtain initial rates over a verified low-substrate regime or full concentration series. Report v0/[E][S] or kcat/KM with uncertainty and independently identify the cognate cleavage bond by product mass spectrometry.

interpretation_update.clarification: The earlier record preserves author slash annotations at reporter cuts3 and7. Table S2 gives only one TDPn3 C-product mass, which supports cut7; cut3 must remain an author annotation without independent mass support in that row. No earlier source annotation is removed.
